assumptions: Only one adapter host and no external writers are supported.
Schema integers are validated strictly, excluding booleans and numeric strings.
Rejected checkout keys may be retried with a new attempt; successful keys remain bound to their original body.
Listing uses durable snapshots of adapter-published orders; cancellation updates those snapshots.

field_mappings.items[].quantity: lines[].units; preserve duplicate lines and their order

field_mappings.page,page_size: slice published mappings sorted by stable legacy id
field_mappings.orders: durable confirmed or cancelled snapshots; fetch only if a snapshot is absent

workflow.name: validate
workflow.operation: Validate legacy schema and header; persist complete body fingerprint including token and durable attempt number
workflow.retry: Invalid requests have no upstream effects

workflow.name: draft
workflow.operation: POST /orders using deterministic attempt key; checkpoint order_ref
workflow.retry: Repeat identical input/key after ambiguous response
workflow.compensation: Void known draft on permanent rejection

workflow.name: pay
workflow.operation: POST /payments using deterministic attempt payment key
workflow.retry: Repeat identical input/key; 503 returns PENDING without compensation
workflow.compensation: Void only following definitive permanent rejection

workflow.name: confirm
workflow.operation: POST /orders/{order_ref}/confirm; checkpoint confirmed snapshot before allocating legacy id
workflow.retry: Repeat confirmation idempotently; publish only after confirmed response

workflow.name: compensate
workflow.operation: Persist original rejection and retry atomic void until successful
workflow.compensation: Do not report original rejection until void completes

workflow.name: cancel
workflow.operation: Persist cancellation intent; invoke atomic void; update durable snapshot
workflow.retry: Repeat void after lost response; refund and stock restoration are upstream-idempotent

idempotency_strategy: Serialize entire requests with ctx.lock(). Persist the full checkout body fingerprint including token, request identity, attempt number, current step, upstream reference, and terminal outcome. Derive separate draft and payment keys from legacy key and durable attempt number. Resume ambiguous steps with identical upstream input. A successful key compares complete bodies and returns the current order; a permanently rejected and compensated attempt can start a fresh generation.
identifier_strategy: Allocate ctx.id_for only after a confirmed response and durable confirmed snapshot. Resolve incoming ids through ctx.upstream_id; never allocate ids for drafts or rejected workflows.
pagination_strategy: Enumerate only ctx.mappings(), sort by stable legacy integer, and slice using validated page/page_size. Read durable order snapshots maintained by this adapter; cancelled orders remain included. Never enumerate internal upstream drafts. Fallback snapshot retrieval is limited to 75 calls per request and returns PENDING rather than a partial page if exceeded.
limitations: Temporal atomic visibility during pending sagas cannot be preserved; retries are required for reconciliation.
Only adapter-published orders are listed; external writers and preexisting upstream orders are unsupported.
Published mapping enumeration is in-memory and intended for bounded local datasets, not unbounded listings.
Transport headers and unused query parameters are recorded but do not change successful key/body identity.
No probes or tests were run in this single-shot implementation.
